rules: Each final packet receives one immutable design_baseline_id.
Every confirmatory case, artifact, checkpoint, access record, and lane conclusion records that baseline.
Artifacts from different baselines may not be combined for confirmation.
After scientific-result access, a later change to a baseline-bound scientific or computational element triggers prospective impact analysis.
Every affected confirmatory identity, artifact, and checkpoint is retired from confirmation and preserved historically.
The changed design receives a new baseline identity and reopens the applicable review scope before new confirmation.
A changed common dependency propagates invalidation to every dependent lane and artifact.
Prior baseline and access records remain append-only.
